selected_evidence.requirement: Publish zsh, dependencies, metadata, and public key over HTTP on TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: DNF downloaded the 161-RPM dependency closure, createrepo_c indexed it, Apache is enabled and listening on 8080, and node2 received HTTP 200 responses for metadata, its signature, and the public key.
All 161 RPMs passed signature verification, zsh carried the offline signing-key signature, and repomd.xml had a valid detached signature.

selected_evidence.requirement: Enforce repository and RPM signature verification on node2
selected_evidence.summary: node2 validated and imported the exact published key; offline-rhel8 has gpgcheck=1 and repo_gpgcheck=1, and a clean signed-metadata refresh succeeded.

selected_evidence.requirement: Set offline-rhel8 priority 10 and other enabled repositories to lower preference
selected_evidence.summary: offline-rhel8 reports priority 10; enabled AppStream and BaseOS report priority 90.
DNF installed zsh from offline-rhel8; the final RHEL 8.8 client audit shows zsh 5.5.1-10.el8, the custom RPM signature, intact files, and its HTTP repository location.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep zsh reinstallable with every other repository disabled
selected_evidence.summary: An actual DNF reinstall with all repositories disabled except offline-rhel8 downloaded, verified, and reinstalled zsh successfully.
